injected.source: ε_T = p (Li 2015 finds ≈ 0.4p for injection under this noise; we round up); |CCZ⟩ by 8T-to-CCZ distillation, ε = 28 ε_T² (Jones 2013; Gidney & Fowler 2019).

15to1.label: 15-to-1 distillation
15to1.source: Litinski 2019 (Quantum 3, 205), Table 1 at p = 1e-3: (15-to-1)17,7,7, 4.5e-8, 4,620 qubits, 42.6 cycles; (15-to-1)⁶ × (8-to-CCZ), 5.2e-11 per CCZ, 47,000 qubits, 60 cycles. Other p scaled as p³ (one level) and p⁶ (two levels).

cultivation.label: magic-state cultivation
cultivation.source: Gidney, Shutty & Jones 2024: ε_T = 2e-9 at p = 1e-3, 4e-11 at p = 5e-4 (power law between, exponent 5.64); |CCZ⟩ by 8T-to-CCZ, 28 ε_T² (Gidney 2025); footprint from Gidney 2025's factories: six of 3×4 hot patches (1,352 qubits each) give one CCZ per 25 rounds, 2.4e6 qubit·rounds per CCZ.
